metadata.source_selection_policy: Author annotated-cell selection and donor calls retained as deposited; unassigned matrix barcodes excluded, no inferred assignments or new genotyping. Calibrated assignment confidence unavailable.
metadata.source_RNA_QC_policy: Preserve published nCount_RNA/nFeature_RNA as source metadata. Native full-RNA QC independently computed; equality neither assumed nor required. Author-selected assigned cells only; no donor inferred for remaining barcodes.
metadata.source_outcome_policy: Published response_3m and response_1m_or_3m are future outcomes relative to pretreatment sampling, not baseline predictors. Source-computed outcome and treatment metadata retained without imputation.
metadata.source_time_policy: Pretreatment describes CAR-T context and is not treatment-naive. Source time since prior therapy is separate; exact draw dates not supplied by this join.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: Age and sex not independently joined; no cohort-level values assigned to individuals.
metadata.source_alias_policy: Study-scoped canonical codes; cross-study material and donor identity unresolved. Infusion products, receptor assays, bulk references and unmatched Anna_CART_4 are excluded from this acquisition.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; repeated donor/capture views must remain together

title: Anna_CART_5_gene_expression
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs separation by Ficoll centrifugation
Next Gem single-cell 3′ with Feature Barcode technology for Cell Surface Protein v3.1.
data_processing: RNA sequencing data were processed starting with the Cell Ranger software (10x Genomics) to perform quality control, read alignment to the human reference genome (GRCh38), and quantification of gene expression levels. Unique Molecular Identifiers (UMIs) were used to count individual mRNA molecules, ensuring accurate expression levels.

The resultant data were then normalized to account for variations in sequencing depth and cell count discrepancies. Differential expression analysis was conducted using the Seurat package in R, which included scaling, principal component analysis, and clustering to identify cell populations and marker genes.
Bulk 3' sequencing used for 10x cell demultiplexing using Freemuxlet https://demultiplexing-doublet-detecting-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Freemuxlet.html
Assembly: refdata-cellranger-GRCh38-1.2.0
Supplementary files format and content:
For each library:
10x output that contain features barcodes and matrix
feature_ref with antibody barcodes
mapping of patients to 10x cell name and unique cell name in this work
GEO_metadata.tsv: Annotated cells csv format
Seurat_annotated_GEO.rds: Easy to load all main data normalized and annotated

source_count_review.barcode_scope: Source matrix barcode rows; not automatically called or viable cells
